_doc: One settlement system for every place people live. tiers: base (the main camp, level = Furnace Level 1-30), outpost (one per region/biome, content comes later), camp (one per opened location/chunk inside a region). A tier's level is capped by its parents: a camp by the base (and by its region's outpost once outposts exist). camp.levels[i] = what level i+1 gives; baseLevel = Furnace Level needed. Costs scale with the chunk's distance from the base: x(1 + distanceCost * (distance - 1)).

camp._buildings: Fixed core of every camp. at = offset from the camp centre; requires = other parts that must stand first. The fire is bought with the 'Found camp' zone.
camp._sites: Where the camp stands in a named chunk (world x, z of its centre). Procedural chunks use the chunk centre.
camp._route: Camp -> base hauling. tiers[0] = sled with a driver, [1] = sled road + reindeer team, [2] = log flume (continuous, no sled). capacity = items per trip (flow: items per minute); every throughput level adds levelBonus. Items above each rule's keep amount are sent; logs go to the base's wood stores (furnace / stall / lumber hut), everything else to the Warehouse.
camp._workers: Camp worker places = levels[i].workers. The Woodcutters' Hut hires 2 of them. Auto-assign moves a base lumberjack to a camp only when the camp has a route and that lumberjack's recent trips were longer than autoMoveTrip metres.
